# Steer, cancel and fork a run

An intervention changes what a running mission reads, when it reads it, or which run continues. It never changes the run's program, policy, authority or budget, and it never fulfils or waives a promised output.

## Rules for every intervention

1. Inspect, send, and on `stale_version` resend once. `missionctl run inspect` gives `expected_version` (its `version`) and `expected_generation` (its `execution_generation`). A version moves with every event, so a command beside running work is often stale: nothing was admitted and the refusal carries the current values. Resend once with them; if stale again, inspect and decide.
2. Admission is not delivery. The receipt says the command was accepted; the Delivery Report in the next inspection says what the lane did with it.
3. Repeat a request whose answer you lost with the same `request_id` and body. A new id is a new command.
4. When a notification is the reason, send the command with `POST coordinator-inboxes/{subscription_id}/notifications/{notification_id}/commands` (HTTP route; no missionctl command): it is recorded as caused by it and bounded by the inbox's limits.

## The interventions

| Intervention | `kind` | What happens | Call |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Queue an instruction | `queue_instruction` | Read once at the next turn or iteration boundary; work continues. | `missionctl command queue` |
| Add context | `add_context` | An artifact or a short note joins the next Context Packet. | `missionctl command queue --add-context` |
| Interrupt and inject | `interrupt_and_inject` | Delivered now, in the way the lane declares below. | `missionctl command inject` |
| Cancel | `cancel` | `urgency: normal` stops at the next safe boundary. `immediate` first writes a Stop Fence: every later effect of the run is denied; a tool already dispatched is not halted. | `missionctl command cancel` |
| Pause, resume, satisfy a wait, request continuation | `pause`, `resume`, `satisfy_wait`, `request_continuation` | Applied at a boundary. A resume adds no authority or budget. | `missionctl command send` |
| Fork | its own call | Admits, never starts, a new run from a Snapshot of this one, optionally from a cognition point and with a first instruction, under a `sponsorship_ref` you hold (`missionctl whoami`). The source run is not written; its in-flight commands and active children are not copied. | `missionctl run fork`, then `missionctl mission start` |
| State as of | read-only | The agent's state at one cognition point. | `missionctl run points`, then `missionctl run state-as-of` |

A fork needs a Snapshot, taken only at a safe boundary: a run waiting at a Human Gate refuses it (`CHECKPOINT_INVALID`) until the gate is resolved or the run ends. `missionctl describe tool:NAME` gives the full request of a command or a fork, and when a fork is possible.

## What each lane does

| Lane profile | `queue_instruction` | `interrupt_and_inject` | `pause` | `resume` | `cancel` | `fork` | `request_continuation` | controls: pause / snapshot / fork | restore: read / fork |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `claude_agent_sdk` | turn_boundary_guaranteed | cancel_and_replace | pause_at_tool_gate | turn_boundary_guaranteed | turn_boundary_guaranteed | emulated | emulated | unqualified / emulated / emulated | R3 / R3 |
| `claude_cloud` | wait_then_send | cancel_and_replace | unsupported | wait_then_send | unsupported | unsupported | emulated | unqualified / unqualified / unqualified | not declared |
| `claude_managed`, `codex_agents` | wait_then_send | cancel_and_replace | unsupported | wait_then_send | turn_boundary_guaranteed | emulated | emulated | unqualified / unqualified / unqualified | R1 / R1 |
| `codex` | wait_then_send | cancel_and_replace | pause_at_tool_gate | wait_then_send | turn_boundary_guaranteed | emulated | emulated | emulated / emulated / emulated | R3 / R3 |
| `codex_cloud` | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unsupported | unqualified / unqualified / unqualified | not declared |
| `cursor_cloud`, `cursor_local` | wait_then_send | cancel_and_replace | unsupported | wait_then_send | turn_boundary_guaranteed | emulated | emulated | unsupported / emulated / emulated | R2 / R2 |
| `deep_agents` | turn_boundary_guaranteed | cooperative_inject | pause_at_tool_gate | turn_boundary_guaranteed | turn_boundary_guaranteed | emulated | emulated | native / emulated / emulated | R3 / R3 |

Delivery: `turn_boundary_guaranteed` at the next turn boundary; `wait_then_send` once the running turn ends; `cooperative_inject` joins the next model call; `cancel_and_replace` cancels the running turn, settles its uncertain effects and runs a replacement turn on the same session (an effect that cannot settle parks the unit `in_doubt`); `pause_at_tool_gate` holds the turn at its next tool call; `emulated` Mission Control provides it around the provider; `unsupported` a typed rejection.

Restore: `R0` the packet only; `R1` plus the transcript to the point; `R2` plus the workspace files; `R3` the provider's own state. A point seeds a fork only where the lane's fork level is `R1` or above.
